blocks.content: Silences live in the Alerting section of Grafana. In this milestone you navigate to the Silences page and prepare to create a new silence.
To navigate to the Silences page, complete the following steps:
In Grafana Cloud, navigate to **Alerts & IRM > Alerting > Silences** from the main menu.

The Silences page shows any existing silences and their status (active, expired, or pending).

Click **Add Silence** to start creating a new silence.
In the next milestone, you will configure the silence with label matchers and a duration.
